info.title: jd-efcpt: CLI companion for JD.Efcpt.Build
info.description: dotnet-tool CLI companion for JD.Efcpt.Build. `jd-efcpt init` bootstraps an efcpt-config.json (offline-first, from the bundled schema); `jd-efcpt doctor` reports how the MSBuild pipeline would resolve and run the efcpt tool for a given target framework, without a full build.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: jd-efcpt: CLI companion for JD.Efcpt.Build (init, doctor).

options.name: --provider
options.description: Database provider (mssql, postgres, mysql, sqlite, oracle, firebird, snowflake). Validated only; recorded for your reference.

options.name: --dbcontext-name
options.description: Name of the generated DbContext class (default: ApplicationDbContext).

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Root namespace for generated code (default: EfcptProject).

options.name: --online
options.description: Fetch the latest efcpt-config schema from GitHub instead of using the schema bundled with this tool. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Emit detailed diagnostics, including full exception details (type + stack trace) on failure. [default: False]

arguments.name: OUTPUT_DIR
arguments.description: Directory to write efcpt-config.json into (defaults to the current directory).

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Diagnose how the efcpt tool would be resolved and run.

options.name: --target-framework
options.description: Target framework to diagnose (e.g. net8.0, net10.0). [default: ]

options.name: --tool-mode
options.description: Tool resolution mode: auto, tool-manifest, or global. [default: auto]

options.name: --tool-package-id
options.description: The dotnet tool package id. [default: ErikEJ.EFCorePowerTools.Cli]

options.name: --tool-path
options.description: Explicit path to the efcpt executable, bypassing automatic resolution. [default: ]

options.name: --offline
options.description: Diagnose as if EfcptOfflineMode were enabled. [default: False]

options.name: --auto-acquire
options.description: Diagnose as if EfcptAutoAcquireTool were enabled. [default: True]

options.name: --strict
options.description: Exit with code 1 (instead of 2) when no viable execution path is found. [default: False]

options.name: --working-dir
options.description: Working directory used for tool-manifest discovery (defaults to the current directory). [default: ]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Emit full exception details (type + stack trace) on an unexpected failure. [default: False]
